conditions.baseline: Preserved immediate pre-change factory; only relative asset base rewritten to the original runtime URL. Same current soundscape/master/peak guard and decoded local assets.
conditions.audibilityMeasurement: Each stage window subtracts its identical ambient-only render after the production master. RMS ratio describes the incremental output relative to that ambient and includes nonlinear master/compressor interaction; it is not an isolated linear stem or a perceptual masking threshold. Near launch uses [29,1.3,7] to [0,0,0]; island-edge listener is [-65,30,54].

limits: Offline production PCM verifies actual output differences, tail energy, clipping and scheduling; it does not establish subjective listening quality or speaker calibration.
Stage RMS relative to ambient is a physical output ratio, not a guarantee of perceptual audibility.
Sample peak is not intersample true peak. Maximum48-event stress is intentionally bounded by24 voices.
Sound type/seed is authored timbre selection; not a measured model of pyrotechnic chemistry.
